别名

  • BLACKRAINBOW FANDISC 黒虹本2

あらすじ

The second ‘illustrated book+disk’ combo from Black Rainbow comes with a DVD also containing three ‘What-If’ side stories.

Scenario 1 and 3 are, respectively, a cousin romance Love Story and a mind control Dark Story from Saiminjutsu 2, Scenario 2 is an Oedipus Complex mind control extravaganza (DON’T ASK!) with characters from three different Black Rainbow games.

item.title: Fukou na Kami
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: BLACKRAINBOW
  • 発売日: 2006-04-28
  • スコア: 7.07/10 (40 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 不幸な神
  • 英語名: Fukou na Kami

あらすじ

The pain and sorrow of a protagonist who gained the power to grant wishes.

Forbidden from fulfilling his own desires…

Yet can he truly continue to love her…?

The protagonist is a student living in a small rural town with his father and younger sister. His life turns upside down after encountering Oshiro-sama – a god nobody usually interacts with – and jokingly making a promise to switch places with her. Through this, he gains the ability to make others’ wishes come true. But because of this power, the protagonist sinks to the rock bottom of misery…
